# Invoke-ZbxUserProvision

## SYNOPSIS

Updates users from their user directory now.

## SYNTAX

```
Invoke-ZbxUserProvision [-InputObject] <ZabbixReference<ZabbixUser>[]> [-Connection <ZabbixConnection>] [-WhatIf] [-Confirm] [<CommonParameters>]
```

## DESCRIPTION

The Invoke-ZbxUserProvision cmdlet asks the server, with user.provision, to update the users given to -InputObject (names, ids or piped users) from the LDAP user directory they were provisioned from: their name, user groups, role and media, as the directory's group and media mappings say. A user who was not provisioned from a directory is refused. The command writes nothing, and -WhatIf shows what it would update.

## EXAMPLES

### Example 1: Update a provisioned user now

```powershell
Invoke-ZbxUserProvision -InputObject 'jdoe' -WhatIf
```

The directory's mappings decide the user's groups and media; -WhatIf shows the user the command would update.

### Example 2: Update every user of a group

```powershell
Get-ZbxUser -UserGroup 'Operators' | Invoke-ZbxUserProvision -WhatIf
```

Get-ZbxUser writes the users, and the command asks for all of them in one call.
